```sql
WITH paid_search_spend AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN a.currency = 'AUD' THEN a.spend_local * f.aud_nzd_rate 
            ELSE a.spend_local 
        END) AS ad_spend
    FROM staging.stg_marketing__ad_spend a
    JOIN reference.marketing_channels mc ON a.marketing_channel = mc.marketing_channel
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__fx_rates f ON a.spend_date = f.rate_date
    WHERE a.spend_date >= '2025-10-01' 
      AND a.spend_date <= '2025-12-31'
      AND mc.is_paid = TRUE
      AND (LOWER(a.marketing_channel) LIKE '%search%' OR LOWER(mc.channel_name) LIKE '%search%')
),
paid_search_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN o.currency = 'AUD' THEN (ol.line_total) * f.aud_nzd_rate 
            ELSE ol.line_total 
        END) AS attributed_revenue
    FROM staging.stg_ecom__orders o
    JOIN staging.stg_ecom__order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN reference.marketing_channels mc ON o.marketing_channel = mc.marketing_channel
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__fx_rates f ON o.order_date = f.rate_date
    WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' 
      AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
      AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'
      AND mc.is_paid = TRUE
      AND (LOWER(o.marketing_channel) LIKE '%search%' OR LOWER(mc.channel_name) LIKE '%search%')
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(COALESCE(r.attributed_revenue, 0) / NULLIF(s.ad_spend, 0), 4) AS answer
FROM paid_search_spend s
CROSS JOIN paid_search_revenue r;
```
